profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Figma — specialized in GraphQL-driven SDUI, Frontend technologies, and architectural design
profile.summary:
Hi there, I’m Pedro 👋 

I’m a senior software engineer with expertise in frontend technologies, full stack architecture, and GraphQL-driven SDUI design.

I focus on building reliable, efficient, and maintainable systems. My experience spans everything from bespoke apps for small teams to large-scale ecosystems supporting hundreds of engineers and millions+ in annual revenue.

I excel at balancing technical execution with product vision, ensuring engineering goals align with business outcomes. Strong communication and presentation skills have helped me build effective partnerships across QA, Product, and Management.

Outside of work, I’m an avid hobbyist who enjoys historical fencing, Muay Thai, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, latte art, and competitive dance—from West Coast Swing and Argentine Tango to ballroom.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.insights: Software Design, Software Systems Engineering and +1 skill

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered Zillow Home Loans’ flagship customer experience as part of Zillow’s first production ChatGPT integration, embedding AI-driven workflows into a core customer journey for 300K visits since launch.

Architected a cross-platform GraphQL-driven SDUI platform supporting 157K annual viable leads, 48K annual assigns, and 6.3K annual digital funded loans, including 350+ verified credit pulls/day (87% success) and 1.5K pre-approval views/day.

Designed a domain-driven, high-fidelity test data architecture that improved automated test reliability and increased testing adoption across Zillow Home Loans, saving 40K engineering hours annually.

Led a focused cross-functional team to remediate digital access issues, increasing successful completion rates for high-intent customers from 89% to 96%.

Drove cross-team architectural standards for GraphQL schema design and SDUI contracts, improving consistency and reducing integration friction across product teams.

Diagnosed systemic duplicate lead ingestion and designed an architectural solution that reduced duplication by 30% and was incorporated into the long-term platform roadmap.

Served as the organization’s AI champion, leading MCP-backed tooling and redistributable skill architectures and driving cross-team adoption of AI-assisted development workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to a strategic reorganization of mortgage architecture, clarifying domain ownership, reducing cross-team coupling, and improving independent delivery velocity.

Led migration of customer-facing applications from REST to GraphQL and from JavaScript to TypeScript, aligning with enterprise standards and improving type safety and delivery velocity.

Served as technical lead for a down-funnel conversion initiative, standing up a greenfield Next.js service backed by new GraphQL services to improving loan process clarity and conversion performance, supporting 5.5K funded loans annually.

Advanced internal application archetypes used to bootstrap new services, improving AWS integration and reducing coupling to legacy foundations.

Architected a microfrontend integration model to dynamically serve Zillow Home Loans navigation within Zillow’s shared page scaffolding infrastructure, reaching 300M monthly users.

positions.title: GG2210-1 Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as primary design engineer across eight greenfield web applications supporting multiple mission domain stakeholders.

Designed and delivered a business process modeling workflow system that replaced a $1M legacy program and reduced ongoing development costs by approximately $100K annually.

Led frontend modernization from ES5 to ESNext, introduced TDD practices, and implemented a component-driven design system using Storybook and Vue styled components.

Championed automated testing and TDD adoption across engineering teams.

It encourages rapid development and clean, pragmatic design while leveraging TypeScript's powerful type system for maximum safety and developer experience.
